name: Bottom Sheet

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: ConversationList, TodoEditSheet, SplitConfirmSheet all use showModalBottomSheet with radius-card-header (20px)

representativeVariants.whySelected: Draggable sheet — conversation list, main pattern
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: drag handle + title row + divider + scrollable list

representativeVariants.whySelected: Edit sheet — todo edit, fixed controls
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: drag handle + title input + body textarea + action chips + save/delete buttons

representativeVariants.whySelected: Confirm sheet — split confirm, simple list + buttons
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: drag handle + title + subtitle + checkbox list + cancel/confirm buttons

representativeVariants.name: Time Picker
representativeVariants.whySelected: Timer setting panel — modify and clear timer entries
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: drag handle + modify-timer ListTile + clear-timer ListTile

representativeVariants.name: Month View
representativeVariants.whySelected: Full-screen month overlay — hand-tracking drag + spring snap animation
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: drag handle + month calendar grid + date cells + navigation controls

usageHints: All bottom sheets share top-radius 20px, drag handle 36x4, and horizontal padding 16px
Draggable sheets use DraggableScrollableSheet with initialChildSize ~0.6
Picker and time-picker sheets are modal with dismiss-on-outside-tap
Month-view is a full-screen overlay (initialChildSize 1.0) with spring snap animation
